title: Troubleshooting and Upkeep
grammar: Process Reflexives (-ódik/-ődik), Procedural Connectors & Technical Descriptions
goal: I can say that a breakdown occurred and was fixed, using üzemzavar lép fel and elhárít.
I can say that something works with greater efficiency, using hatékonysággal.
I can talk about maintenance, efficiency and performance (karbantartás, hatékonyság, teljesítmény).
